cond_0001.intro: As a Benefits Analyst at the GS-0301-09/11, you will be part of the Program Analysis and Development (PAD) Group, Program Development and Support (PDS) within the Healthcare and Insurance (HI) Division of [Company name masked]. If selected, you will be responsible for the identification, analysis, development, and enunciation of Federal insurance benefits for all eligible individuals.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy.
Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs.
Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs.
Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level.
You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Preferred Requirements
For GS-09: Master's or equivalent graduate degree, or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree, or LL.B or J.D. Accepted degrees: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) OR a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-09 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
For GS-11: Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree, or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. Accepted degrees: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) OR a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

cond_0021.intro: As a Benefits Analyst at the GS-0301-09/11, you will be part of the Program Analysis and Development (PAD) Group, Program Development and Support (PDS) within the Healthcare and Insurance (HI) Division of [Company name masked]. If selected, you will be responsible for the identification, analysis, development, and enunciation of Federal insurance benefits for all eligible individuals.
cond_0021.responsibilities: Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy. Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0021.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
Minimum Requirements
For the GS 09: Around one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Presenting information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
OR a master's or equivalent graduate degree, or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree, or LL.B or J.D. — Or an equivalent combination of education and experience that qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Around one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
OR a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree, or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. — Or an equivalent combination of education and experience that qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
Preferred Requirements
Accepted degree fields include: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs.
Merit promotion applicants should be aware of time-in-grade requirements as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. Around one year at the GS-07 is needed for the GS-09 level; around one year at the GS-09 is needed for the GS-11 level.
You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of Federal benefits policy and how regulatory and legislative changes affect program design.
cond_0265.responsibilities: Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy. Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0265.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0478.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation May be required to successfully complete a probationary period Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

cond_0506.intro: As a Benefits Analyst at the GS-0301-09/11, you will be part of the Program Analysis and Development (PAD) Group, Program Development and Support (PDS) within the Healthcare and Insurance (HI) Division of [Company name masked]. If selected, you will be responsible for the identification, analysis, development, and enunciation of Federal insurance benefits for all eligible individuals.
cond_0506.responsibilities: Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy. Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0506.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
Minimum Requirements
For the GS 09: Demonstrated expertise of at least one year at a scope and responsibility comparable to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Presenting written analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
For the GS 11: Demonstrated expertise of at least one year at a scope and responsibility comparable to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience.
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level.
You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Preferred Requirements
For the GS 09: Advanced degree strongly preferred — master's or equivalent graduate degree, or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree, or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) Accepted degrees: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs. A combination of qualifying experience and education will also be considered. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Advanced degree strongly preferred — Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree, or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) Accepted degrees: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs. A combination of qualifying experience and education will also be considered. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with benefits policy analysis and research.
cond_0536.responsibilities: Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy. Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0536.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

cond_0565.responsibilities:
Conduct legal research to develop, clarify, and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy.
Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs.
Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs.
Coordinate with other agency offices on assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0565.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National
Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service
Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required
This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286) If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Documenting analysis in writing regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) OR Have a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing professional documents such as regulations, legislative language, or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) OR Have a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirements as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Preferred Requirements
Accepted degree fields: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, or other related degree programs
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. cond_0587.intro: As a Benefits Analyst at the GS-0301-09/11, you will be part of the Program Analysis and Development (PAD) Group, Program Development and Support (PDS) within the Healthcare and Insurance (HI) Division of [Company name masked]. If selected, you will be responsible for the identification, analysis, development, and enunciation of Federal insurance benefits for all eligible individuals.
cond_0587.responsibilities: Conduct legal research to develop, clarify and reinforce Federal insurance benefits policy. Evaluate changes and trends in Federal insurance benefit programs to analyze the implications of such changes with respect to Federal insurance benefit programs. Prepare reports on regulatory, legislative, or other activities/initiatives that impact Federal insurance benefit programs. Work with other agency offices in assessment or support of Federal insurance benefit programs.
cond_0587.requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation. May be required to successfully complete a probationary period. Complete the initial online assessment and USAHire Assessment, if required. This position is eligible for inclusion in the bargaining unit. If the duty station is finalized in the [Location masked] metropolitan area, employees in this position will be represented by the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) Local 32. (BU Code - 2286). If the duty station is finalized outside of the [Location masked] metropolitan area, this position will not be represented by a bargaining unit. (BU Code - 7777)
For the GS 09: Must have one year of demonstrated expertise comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Presenting information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings with strong command of professional written communication. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Advanced degree required: a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D.; advanced degree strongly preferred. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of demonstrated expertise comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Substantial experience in analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Proven track record in contributing to the development of benefits program policy; and 3) Advanced knowledge of writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program, with exceptional written and oral communication skills. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Advanced degree required: a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M.; advanced degree strongly preferred. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have a combination of experience and education that qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy of your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement. Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For the GS 09: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-07 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Conducting work to support benefit programs such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Conducting studies that involved any aspect of a benefit program; and 3) Present information in writing of analysis regarding benefits policy, research, and/or evaluation findings. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree or 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a master's degree or LL.B or J.D. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-9 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
For the GS 11: Must have one year of specialized experience comparable in scope and responsibility to the GS-09 grade level in the Federal service (obtained in either the private or public sector) performing the following: 1) Assisting with analysis and evaluation of benefits program policies such as health, dental/vision and life insurance; 2) Providing input for the development of a benefits program policy; and 3) Writing and presenting professional documents such as regulations, legislative language or guidance related to a benefits program. Note: Your resume must fully support this experience. OR Have a Ph.D or equivalent doctoral degree or 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to a Ph.D or LL.M. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.) Accepted degrees for this position are as follows: Business Administration, Management, Political Science, Public Policy, other related degree programs. OR Have combination of experience and education with qualifies for the GS-11 level. (You must submit a copy your transcripts.)
Merit promotion applicants must meet time-in-grade requirement as defined in 5 CFR 300, Subpart F. One year at the GS-07 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-09 level. One year at the GS-09 is required to meet the time-in-grade requirements for the GS-11 level. You must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.
Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.
